act.name: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law declaring instant triple talaq void and protecting affected Muslim women's allowance and custody rights.

sections.title: Subsistence allowance.
sections.text: Section 5 entitles an affected married Muslim woman to a subsistence allowance determined by the Magistrate.
sections.plain_language_summary: A Muslim woman affected by prohibited instant talaq may seek a Magistrate-determined subsistence allowance for herself and dependent children.
